With 3 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms, this home offers wonderful accommodations for 8 guests.Expansive outdoor porches and an elegant cottage faÃ§ade welcome guests to this gorgeous property. Inside, an open-concept floorplan joins the living, dining, and kitchen areas. The well-appointed living room boasts a plush sectional sofa, a large mounted flat-screen television, and a built-in daybed nook. The nearby dining area offers seating for 8 guests.
